no_teachers: No teachers added yet. Click 'Add Teacher' to start.
confirm_reset: Are you sure you want to delete the current project? All unsaved data will be lost.
confirm_delete_teacher: Are you sure you want to delete this teacher?
confirm_delete_subject: Are you sure you want to delete this subject?
confirm_delete_room: Are you sure you want to delete this room?
confirm_delete_group: Are you sure you want to delete this group?
confirm_delete_rule: Are you sure you want to delete this curriculum rule?
confirm_delete_selected: Are you sure you want to delete {{count}} selected curriculum rule(s)?
confirm_delete_all: Are you sure you want to delete ALL {{count}} curriculum rules? This cannot be undone.
no_selection: Please select a {{type}} to view their schedule.
manage_structure_desc: Start by defining your structure or generating a schedule.
name: Name
click_to_lock_lesson: Double-click to keep this lesson in place
click_to_unlock_lesson: Double-click to allow this lesson to move
subject: Subject
generate_schedule_first: Generate a schedule to view it here.
generate_btn_hint: Generate a schedule. Opens settings so you can choose a runs- or time-based run.
generate_settings_hint: Choose how the scheduler runs. Runs mode generates a fixed number of candidate schedules; time mode keeps improving against a deadline and returns the best schedule found.
generate_mode_hint: Runs: generate and keep the best of a fixed number of candidates. Time: keep improving against the deadline and return the best schedule when it elapses.
generate_attempts_hint: How many candidate schedules to generate and keep the best of. Higher values take longer but usually produce a better result.
generate_time_ms_hint: How long the anytime optimizer may improve the schedule before returning the best one it found.
generate_max_spill_passes_hint: How many times lessons that do not fit in one semester may be moved into the other semester.
generate_optimize_passes_hint: How many local-search rounds shrink teacher free gaps after placement. Higher values tighten schedules but take slightly longer.
confirm_clear_schedule: Are you sure you want to clear the generated schedule? This cannot be undone.
report_all_desc: Complete weekly grid with every lesson and all its details.
report_with_teachers_desc: Matrix by class showing the subject and assigned teacher for each slot.
report_only_lessons_desc: Compact matrix by class showing subject names only.
report_teacher_load_desc: Rows are teachers, columns are weekdays with periods; cells show classes.
report_more: More report types are coming soon.
select_at_least_one: Select at least one class to export.
export_no_data: No lessons found for the selected classes.
constraints_desc: Define rules the schedule generator must respect when building the schedule.
constraints_affect_gen: Constraints are applied the next time you generate the schedule.
forbid_lesson_hint: Pick one or more lessons and a semester, then set the hours distributed to that semester for each (0 forbids the lesson there). One constraint is created per lesson; existing ones are updated.
duplicate_constraint: A constraint with these exact settings already exists.
duplicate_rule: A curriculum rule with these exact settings already exists.
no_teachers_no_subjects: Add teachers and subjects first to define constraints.
max_daily_hint: Pick one or more lessons and set the maximum times each may appear on any single day. Lessons that would push the daily count beyond this are moved to another day. One constraint is created per lesson; existing ones are updated.
auto_daily_limits_desc: Derived from the load distribution: a lesson is limited to 2 per day when its weekly load is over 5 hours, otherwise 1 per day (double lessons keep their pair). Explicit Max lessons / day constraints override these for a lesson.
confirm_delete_constraint: Are you sure you want to delete this constraint?
confirm_delete_selected_constraint: Are you sure you want to delete {{count}} selected constraint(s)?
confirm_delete_all_constraint: Are you sure you want to delete ALL {{count}} constraints? This cannot be undone.
unfilled_gaps_desc: Empty slots in the middle of a class's day that could not be filled.
unassigned_click_hint: Click to see which lessons could not be placed
gaps_click_hint: Click to see which slots could not be filled
editor_confirm_reset: Discard all manual edits and reload the generated schedule?
editor_checker_hint: Drag lessons here to remove them from the schedule
editor_hint: Select a class, then drag its lessons between days, periods and the unassigned area. Conflicts with other classes are highlighted red.
editor_hint_teacher: Select a teacher, then drag their lessons between days, periods and the unassigned area. Each block shows the class it belongs to; conflicts are highlighted red.
editor_hint_filter: Choose a class, teacher or subject, then drag its lessons between days, periods and the unassigned area. Conflicts are highlighted red.
rearrange_confirm_desc: To place the lesson where you dropped it, a few neighbouring lessons must move as well. Review the changes below and confirm to apply them.
rearrange_choose_title: Choose how to place the lesson
rearrange_choose_desc: There are several valid ways to fit this lesson. Pick the one you prefer.
conflict_teacher_slot: Teacher already has another lesson at this time
conflict_group_slot: Group already has a different lesson at this time
conflict_room_slot: Room is occupied at this time
conflict_teacher_busy_constraint: Teacher busy constraint forbids this time
conflict_no_first_period: This subject cannot be the first lesson
conflict_out_of_range: Outside the group's allowed period range
conflict_daily_overload: Group exceeds its daily lesson limit
conflict_daily_rule: This lesson appears more than its daily limit
empty_slot_curriculum_done: All lessons for this group are already placed
empty_slot_daily_cap: Group is at its daily lesson limit
empty_slot_teacher_busy: Every available teacher is busy at this time
empty_slot_room_busy: The preferred room is occupied at this time
empty_slot_no_first: These subjects cannot be the first lesson
empty_slot_day_balance: Left empty to balance the daily load
empty_slot_daily_rule: This lesson already reached its daily limit on that day
needed_distribution_hint: Lessons the entered curriculum requires per semester. Rows that are not yet fully placed for the active semester are highlighted.
